text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position from opening through conclusion","quality":"argumentative stance consistency","description":"The essay keeps a steady, explicit claim about supporting driverless cars and returns to that claim throughout."},{"evidence":"\"However\" then \"On the contrast\" sections","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses distinct opposing and supporting sections to structure its argument more clearly."},{"evidence":"focus on liability, cost, and stress","quality":"relevant reasoning","description":"The essay develops multiple argument points that connect directly to the article’s discussion of benefits and concerns."},{"evidence":"driverless cars would \"save tons of money\" and reduce \"stress and anxitety\"","quality":"development of support","description":"The essay explains its reasons with more elaboration instead of only mentioning them briefly."},{"evidence":"references to takeover ability, vibrating seats, and entertainment systems","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay incorporates several concrete details from the article to support its claims."},{"evidence":"repeated rebuttal of concerns about driver boredom and safety","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges objections and answers them rather than just stating one side."}]}
